leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a token refresh service that manages authentication token lifecycle
Configure HTTP interceptors to automatically attach tokens to outgoing requests
Construct a token rotation mechanism that replaces expired tokens with fresh ones
Initialize secure storage for tokens using Angular's built-in services
Integrate token validation logic to check expiration before API calls
Apply error handling to manage token refresh failures gracefully
Bind token refresh events to user interface components for real-time feedback
